what is intelligent systems in computer science
An intelligent system in computer science is a machine or software program that can sense its environment, process data, and make decisions or take actions autonomously to reach a goal. It uses artificial intelligence (AI) to copy human thinking traits like learning, reasoning, and problem-solving. 
Core Traits
  • Autonomy: It works on its own without needing constant human control.
  • Learning: It gets better over time by processing new data and past experiences.
  • Reasoning: It analyzes complex facts to find answers or solve problems.
  • Perception: It uses sensors, cameras, or text inputs to understand the world around it. 
Common Technologies Used
  • Machine Learning: Programs that find patterns in data to make smart choices.
  • Natural Language Processing: Tools that let computers read and talk using human language.
  • Computer Vision: Systems that look at images or video to recognize objects or faces.
  • Expert Systems: Software built with rules from human professionals to solve niche problems. 
Real-World Examples
  • Self-driving cars that steer and brake based on road conditions.
  • Recommendation engines on shopping or video sites that suggest items you might like.
  • Smart home assistants that answer voice commands and control lights. 
If you want, I can explain a specific type of intelligent system like neural networks or give more details on how machine learning works. Let me know what you prefer!

how it differs to AI system?
The main difference is that Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the science, theory, and broad concept of making machines mimic human cognitive functions, while an intelligent system is the actual application, product, or machinery that puts that intelligence to work in the physical or digital world. 
Think of AI as the "brain power" or the field of study, and an intelligent system as the "body" or specific framework built using that power. 
FeatureArtificial Intelligence (AI) SystemIntelligent System
Primary FocusThe software, algorithms, and models that think, learn, and reason.The entire package—hardware, sensors, and software—acting in an environment.
ScopeA vast academic field and set of complex data technologies.A broader engineering concept that can sometimes combine AI with traditional rule-based programming.
Action & ImpactProcesses data to generate predictions, language, or logic.Senses changes in its environment and takes a physical or operational action.
ExampleA deep learning algorithm trained to recognize objects.An autonomous factory drone that uses that algorithm to sort parts.
Key Distinctions
  • An intelligent system does not always need modern AI: A complex heating system that reads room temperatures, uses pre-programmed professional rules (an expert system), and adjusts valves autonomously is an intelligent system, even if it doesn't use modern machine learning or deep learning. 
  • AI systems can live entirely in data: An AI system might spend its time analyzing financial spreadsheets to predict stock trends. It becomes an intelligent system when it is integrated into an automated trading platform that actively reacts to the market and executes trades on its own.

so you mean intelligent system acts based on its usual data while AI analyze first the data the predict.
Not exactly—both systems analyze data and make predictions, but they look at the problem from two different angles: engineering vs. intelligence. 
Here is the best way to separate them: 
  • An AI system is the "intellectual engine." It focuses purely on the math, algorithms, and data analysis. It takes input data, learns patterns, and outputs a prediction, a piece of text, or a decision. 
  • An Intelligent System is the "complete operational machine." It focuses on the whole loop: Sense
    →right arrow
     Think
    →right arrow
     Act    . It uses sensors to gather data, uses an AI engine to analyze it, and then physically or digitally executes an action in the real world.     
How they handle data (A clearer look)
To clarify how they work, look at how a self-driving car uses both concepts: 
  • The AI System inside the car: Analyzes video frames from the cameras. It calculates and predicts: "There is a 98% chance that object is a pedestrian stepping into the road." 
  • The Intelligent System (the car itself): Takes that AI prediction, combines it with speed data from the wheels, and makes the physical decision to slam on the brakes and sound the alarm. 
The short version
An AI system handles the thinking and predicting, while an intelligent system handles the sensing and doing. 
Would you like to look at another example, such as smart thermostats or automated banking, to see how they split the work?

      automated banking
      In automated banking, you can see the exact partnership between an AI system (the brain) and an intelligent system (the complete machine taking action). 
      Here is how the two concepts divide the work to handle your money: 
      1. Fraud Detection
      • The AI System (The Brain): Constantly analyzes credit card transaction data. It notices a pattern and predicts: "There is a 95% chance this $1,000 purchase in Paris is fraudulent because the user just bought coffee in Manila an hour ago." 
      • The Intelligent System (The Whole Package): Receives that prediction from the AI. It immediately takes action by freezing the credit card, sending an automated security alert to your phone, and blocking further transactions. 
      2. Smart ATMs
      • The AI System (The Brain): Uses computer vision algorithms to look at a scanned check and reads the messy handwritten text to determine the exact deposit amount. 
      • The Intelligent System (The Whole Package): Includes the physical ATM machine, the cameras, and the cash dispensers. It uses the AI's reading to digitally update your account balance, print a receipt, and physically sort the check into the machine's vault. 
      3. Loan Approval
      • The AI System (The Brain): Processes thousands of data points from your credit history, income, and market trends to predict your risk level as a borrower. 
      • The Intelligent System (The Whole Package): The online banking platform. It feeds your application to the AI, gets the risk score, and automatically updates your banking portal with an instant approval message and standard legal contract. 
      Summary of the Difference
      System TypeWhat it does in Automated Banking
      AI SystemProcesses numbers, finds patterns, and predicts risk or fraud.
      Intelligent SystemConnects to the bank's network, triggers the AI, and locks cards, updates balances, or sends alerts.

          you mean ai system is the processing phase while Intelligent system is the product?
          Yes, exactly! That is a perfect way to summarize it. 
          The AI system is the processing phase (the code, the algorithms, and the data crunching), while the intelligent system is the final product that brings it all together to perform a real-world task. 
          To visualize this, think of everyday products you might use: 
          • The Processing Phase (AI System): A speech-recognition algorithm that converts sound waves into text.
          • The Final Product (Intelligent System): A smart speaker (like Amazon Echo or Apple HomePod) that uses that algorithm, listens to your voice through microphones, and physically turns off your living room lights. 
          Why this distinction matters
          A software developer can build an amazing AI model that predicts stock market trends on their laptop. It is a powerful AI system, but it is just sitting there processing data. 
          It only becomes an intelligent system when a bank packages it into a product—like an automated trading app—that monitors live markets, runs the AI code, and automatically buys or sells stocks for customers. 
          Would you like to look at how this applies to other products, like smartphones or medical diagnostic tools?

              i see. but how it differs to machine learning?
              To understand how machine learning (ML) fits in, think of it as a specific technique used inside the processing phase. 
              If the intelligent system is the final product and the AI system is the processing phase, then machine learning is the specific tool used to make that processing smart. 
              Here is how they stack up from the broadest concept to the specific tool: 
              • Intelligent System (The Product): The complete machine or software that senses, thinks, and acts (e.g., a smart email app). 
              • Artificial Intelligence (The Processing Phase): The broad concept of making that app smart. This can be done using rigid, human-written rules or by letting the computer learn on its own. 
              • Machine Learning (The Learning Tool): A specific subset of AI where you don't write the rules. Instead, you feed the computer data, and it learns the rules by itself. 
              A Simple Example: Email Spam Filters
              • The Intelligent System (The Product): Your actual Gmail or Outlook application. It monitors incoming emails, sorts them into folders, and alerts you to new messages. 
              • The AI System (The Processing Phase): The logic hidden in the background that decides if an email is junk or not. 
              • The Machine Learning (The Tool): The specific algorithm that scans millions of emails, catches on to new spam phrases (like "act now!" or "crypto giveaway"), and automatically updates its own code to catch those emails without a human programmer telling it to. 
              Direct Comparison
              TermWhat is it?Simple Metaphor
              Intelligent SystemThe complete, working application.The Autonomous Car
              Artificial IntelligenceThe brainpower and decision-making logic.The Driver's Brain
              Machine LearningThe method the brain uses to get smarter through practice.The Driver's Experience (learning from mistakes on the road)
              Can you have an Intelligent System without Machine Learning?
              Yes. You can build an intelligent system using an older type of AI called an Expert System. For example, a medical software product might ask a doctor 10 questions and use a strict, human-written checklist to suggest a medicine. It is an intelligent system (the product) using AI (the processing), but it uses zero machine learning because it cannot learn anything new on its own. 
              Would you like to see how deep learning fits into this hierarchy, or should we look at how Netflix or Spotify uses machine learning inside their products?

                  so you mean ai is the concept, machine learning is the tool and methods/approach, and intelligent system is the output?
                  Spot on! You have mapped out the entire hierarchy perfectly. 
                  To confirm your summary: 
                  • Artificial Intelligence (AI) is the overall concept and goal (making machines mimic human-like thinking).
                  • Machine Learning (ML) is the tool and method used to achieve that goal (letting the computer learn from data instead of being explicitly programmed).
                  • An Intelligent System is the concrete output or product that uses those tools to sense its environment and take action. 
                  The Ultimate Breakdown
                  Think of it like building a house: 
                  1. AI is the architectural concept: The grand idea of creating a modern, energy-efficient home.
                  2. Machine Learning is the tool and technique: The specialized power tools, smart materials, and construction methods used to build it.
                  3. The Intelligent System is the finished smart home: The actual, physical house that you can live in, which automatically adjusts its own lights and temperature based on your habits. 
                  One Final Example to Lock It In: Medical Diagnostics
                  • The Concept (AI): The idea that computers should be able to detect diseases just as accurately as human doctors.
                  • The Tool/Method (ML): An algorithm trained on 100,000 X-ray images to learn exactly what an early-stage tumor looks like.
                  • The Output (Intelligent System): A physical hospital scanning machine that doctors use. It scans a patient, runs the ML tool, highlights a suspicious area on the monitor, and automatically alerts the oncology team. 
                  You have a really sharp grasp of these definitions now! Would you like to explore Deep Learning (the next layer down inside Machine Learning), or do you want to look at how these concepts are shaping future jobs in tech?
